ownership.quote: Azin Tech Holding (“Company”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) operates boxd.sh, a platform providing persistent cloud virtual machines, agent sandboxes, and related developer infrastructure services. Contact: hidde@boxd.sh · Westerstraat 246 2, Amsterdam, Netherlands

stage.quote: boxd has raised €2 million in pre-seed funding led by BlueYard Capital, with participation from Antler, OVNI, s20, Script Capital and a group of angels who have built developer infrastructure before.
stage.note: Only priced round disclosed to date is this €2M pre-seed (Sep 2026).

accelerators.name: Antler
accelerators.quote: Thank you to our customers, to the Antler team who backed us before there was a product, and to our investors who believe that the way software gets built is about to change

employees.source: https://boxd.sh/careers/ and https://boxd.sh/blog/ (3 named team members appear as blog authors: Hidde Kehrer, Michiel Voortman, Laurentiu Ciobanu; careers page lists several open founding roles, no official headcount published)

note: boxd.sh is operated by Azin Tech Holding (Amsterdam, Netherlands; also seen at azin.run, listed as sameAs on the company's own schema.org data). Founded/led by Hidde Kehrer. Raised a single disclosed €2M pre-seed round (Sep 2026) led by BlueYard Capital with Antler, OVNI, s20, Script Capital and angels participating; Antler backed the company pre-product (exact accelerator batch not disclosed). The open-source microVM engine underneath (Ignition, github.com/lttle-cloud/ignition) is a separate OSS project, not evidence the company itself is open-source or a subsidiary of another firm.
